main.description:
The drawers through which the presented authority reaches `doc_id`, each with the access it
gets there. Authorized from the request's `Authorization` metadata rather than a body
`capability`, because the caller asking has no scoped handle on the doc yet: it holds an
identity or some scoped drawers handle, and a doc it reaches through no drawer answers an
empty list, so "not in a drawer" and "not visible" look the same.

errors.description: Keyhive storage or the engine failed; nothing the caller named is at fault.
errors.name: Keyhive

errors.description: A named group or doc id that is not a 32-byte Ed25519 point.
errors.name: InvalidKey

errors.description: A Keyhive group this node does not hold, perhaps not yet synced.
errors.name: UnknownGroup

errors.description: A principal group the caller named that this node does not hold.
errors.name: UnknownPrincipal

errors.description: A peer this node has not met: its keyhive identity arrives with a live connection.
errors.name: UnknownPeer
